summary: Source-reviewed rework recovered Figure 1/abstract MA1 cytotoxicity records, matched the linked DBAASP activity rows to primary-source IC50 evidence, preserved the unresolved cyclic-peptide sequence/modification identity as a caution, and replaced the framework-test review shell with paper-specific adjudication.
adjudication_summary: The original rwk-complete-test-0001 blockers are closed for worker-2, worker-4, and worker-6: activity records are no longer missing, database conflicts are adjudicated without hiding unresolved identity evidence, and final review provenance is source-reviewed. The paper is accepted_with_cautions, not accepted_clean.

semantic_quality_checks.evidence: Five source-supported activity/toxicity records now carry endpoint, raw value, unit, human cell-line target, assay context, and source locators.
DBAASP activity values are source matched; exact sequence/modification identity remains sequence_modified_not_normalized rather than source_verified.
Mechanism layer is limited to anticancer cell-death and expression context; no direct antimicrobial target is overclaimed.
Supplement ZIP was opened through pdftotext; it contains only Figure S1 protein-loading context and no activity/toxicity tables.
No blocking qc_failure_reasons or open rework targets remain after repair.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Accepted with cautions: current-paper DOI/literature and activity values are source reviewed, while exact cyclic peptide sequence/modification identity for DBAASPN_21151 is not source_verified because it is not embedded in local primary materials.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Accepted with cautions: Figure 1/abstract/discussion provide recoverable MA1 IC50 rows and combination viability percentages; full plotted dose-response coordinates are not fabricated from image curves.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Accepted with cautions: source evidence supports cell-death phenotype and expression-context claims, not a direct antimicrobial mechanism or direct molecular target.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_final_review: Accepted with cautions after re-review of XML, PDF text, Figure 1 image, supplementary ZIP PDF, packet locators, and linked DBAASP rows.

caution_findings.note: Current paper names MA1 as a cyclic pentapeptide and supports IC50 values, but local primary material does not provide exact sequence/modification-normalized identity evidence.
Labeled IC50 values are curated; full concentration-response point values were not digitized from the figure image.
The ZIP contains one Figure S1 Coomassie-load PDF and no spreadsheet/office/table activity data.
Final mechanism is constrained to cell-death/expression context; exact molecular target remains unresolved by this paper.
